milestone.title: M28 Tiered Refresh and Polling Strategy

intent.outcome: Each data class has its own TTL; lazy loading defers fetches until panels are shown; refresh pauses on user interaction; controller split (B-01) becomes feasible.

problem.description: Bkp M28 marked Planned; not implemented in wip. Currently the GUI has no tiered strategy: every refresh fetches everything. Depends on M25 (lazy outdated + TTL), M26 (doctor warnings), M27 (taps batch).

in_scope: Per-class TTLs in config (formulae, casks, outdated, taps, services, doctor)
Pause-on-interaction: refresh defers if user has typed or pressed a key recently

acceptance_criteria.description: Each data class has an independent TTL setting in config.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: grep -E 'ttl|TTL' internal/config/*.go shows >= 4 class-scoped settings

acceptance_criteria.description: No panel fetches data until it is selected.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: go test -run TestLazyPanels ./internal/gui/... shows 0 brew calls before any panel select

acceptance_criteria.description: User keypress within 500ms defers scheduled refresh.
